received_works.body:
Dear Minister of State

My name is Weiru and it is a pleasure to meet you. A few weeks ago, I passed through "ZINKI" by Mr. Minister of State. I enjoyed not only the storyline of the scenario, but also the personalities of the NPCs, their detailed backgrounds, and the game system, all of which I had never experienced before. I especially love Kyle, the lover of HO4, and I am living my life with deep affection from him before, during, and after the passage, both as an explorer and as a PL.

I would like to make a request for a picture of myself and NPC "Kyle Odyssey".
I will share the information about my PC below.
Thank you very much for your time.



Situation
A scene where Kyle and his PC are on a date at the aquarium (a place of memories).
Or a scene where he and his PC are cuddling happily.
Please use a situation that is easy for the Minister of State to draw.

About the searcher
He is a curious young man. He loves to surprise people, and recently, surprising Kyle has become his boom.

Appearance
He wears a hoodie and innerwear that resemble a killer whale.
We will share it on Google Drive. If there is anything that is difficult to draw, please feel free to omit it.
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1IqpNPLicfBT9B2FZKObqOOSJuo4PkPrC

IYAKARA☆
https://iachara.com/view/7248945

Hello 国務大臣先生, nice to meet you! I'm interested in your artwork. Would it be possible to request you to design a new outfit for my original character?

/Details of OC
please refer to the URL

/Details of the request
- I’d like to have a long-sleeved fantasy style robe for him (just like the form of his default outfit), primarily in cool color tones.
- Hairstyle can be changed, but please keep some elements of braids.
- Motifs about him that may help visualizing: white raven, hydrangea
- No other restrictions except for things mentioned above, please feel free to draw according to your preferences!

If there is anything inappropriate about this request or fee, please feel free to cancel or request for a resend. Thank you so much for considering my request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1WWFu0iipmvtDgkQx-8y5CLUj2WquL_iS

Hello teacher, I'm a foreigner using a translator, so I'm sorry if I've used the wrong words!
I like your style so much that after I found out where to open the commission, I would like to commission the woman in the picture, who is quiet and introverted, with a cool temperament, like an exotic princess. I'd like to ask you to give me a free hand with the movements, so I'm sorry for your hard work!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10xHlf5Tsx6GIilzT6lZx7e4QA829jGWZ

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/10xHlf5Tsx6GIilzT6lZx7e4QA829jGWZ

I'd like to see a drawing of these two (https://drive.google.com/folderview?id=1BYOtXjmSRjJyXr59WgXdlMUXpdsA2Eu6) riding a motorcycle closely together, or being held by a motorcycle and sticking close together. I'd love to see a picture of them together.

These two people are lovers. They are the type of people who put each other first and foremost in their lives. The girl with black hair (high school student) is the aggressor. The black-haired girl is the one who has a motorcycle license. The black-haired girl is short and thin.
The man with red hair (adult) has a rather sturdy figure, but he wears an oversized jacket and is skinny, so you can draw him as thin as you like. Without his beard, he has a rather young face. It's okay to let him wear a red jacket.

The height difference is about 20cm. Also, the type of motorcycle can be anything that can hold two people. You don't need to wear a helmet.

Thank you very much for your cooperation.

Nice to meet you, please excuse my request.
If you don't mind, I'd like an illustration of these two, please!
You can also choose any costume you like in the reference url.

The two are represented by blue and red flowers, and they have a close family/partner relationship.
They often fight together, so the blood is very good. Their weapons are guns and swords.
The composition and pose are up to you.

I would be very happy if you could draw it.
I'm sorry if I'm rude in any way. Thank you very much.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/19_Ast17s5Zqvz1L8qI5UKpR1Qoc4FXSt

こんにちは。国務大臣さんのアートスタイルが大好きです!
私の二人のキャラクターを一緒に描いてもらえませんか？できれば2人とも10代または20代に感じてほしいです。
服装は、デザインできるならば、新しい服が欲しいです。
宛名/表現の差分/ドラフトがあれば、psdに入れてどうもありがとうございました。

茶色の方は現役将校で、「主と神」の存在を信じています（カトリックに似ています）。優しくていい人そうに見えますが、実際はとても冷めていて、好きな人以外のことは気にしない人です。お菓子やお菓子作りが好きで、監視カメラなどの安心できるものが好き。スライダーは嫌いです。
青い髪の方は、大学に通う士官候補生で、教会の聖歌隊に所属していたことがあり、クラシック音楽や光り物が好きで、内向的で陰気で冷静な性格という設定です。そうでなければ、自分よりも他人に生きてもらいたい、だからいつも傷ついている、そんな少し偏執的で本来は狂気に満ちた性格のキャラクターです。
なお、青の左目は白の瞳、緑の右目は黒の瞳をしています。

2人はかつて同じ孤児院にいた幼馴染で、茶髪の方は青髪のキャラクターが歌うのをとても気に入っていたそうです。スペシャルフォースの戦友です。
青→茶：コントロール、信頼
茶→青：執着、敬慕/憧れ
茶髪のキャラクターを生かすために、青髪のキャラクターは茶髪のキャラクターに常に血液のようなものを提供していました（輸液バッグの中の赤い血液ではなく、基本的には銀色の液体です）。
自由に描いてください。

使用について（お名前がクレジットされます。
*SNSのアイコンとして、個人のオリジナルキャラクターサイトに表示する。
>他の後続のコミッションの参考として
*個人での使用やライブ配信での壁紙としての使用（非商用）。
>友人へのグッズ印刷
